newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends tightly mixed, focus on spreads.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends tightly mixed, focus on spreads.

text.p: NYCE cotton closed barely higher as activity remained focused on the spreads, trading sources said.

The new-crop December contract settled 0.05 cent firmer at 75.66 cents a lb, having ranged from 75.74 cents to 75.45 cents. Spot July ended up 0.08 cent at 72.70 cents, while the rest of the board finished 0.15 to 0.05 cent higher.
Traders said activity could remain dull until the July contract goes off the board on Tuesday. The market is then expected to turn its attention to the fundamental outlook for the new crop.
Warmer temperatures in the Delta and Southeast should improve conditions for the developing crop, while Arizona and California cotton remains in mostly excellent condition.
Open interest in the July contract stood at 11,875 lots, down 4,283 lots from the previous session.
Volume was estimated at 13,500 lots compared with Thursday's official 15,142 lots.
